title:
VOLUME AND SURFACE AREA,
(SURFACE AREA OF PRISMS)
objective: LO: I can calculate the surface area of prisms by finding the area of each face.

content.text: A prism is a 3D shape with a uniform cross-section. Its surface area is the sum of the areas of all its faces: two identical end faces plus the rectangular side faces.
Method: Find the area of the cross-section (end face), double it for both ends, then add the areas of each rectangular side. SA = 2 × (area of cross-section) + (perimeter of cross-section) × length.

examples.expr: SA = 2A + Ph (A = end area, P = perimeter, h = length)

examples.desc: that gives volume, not surface area

key_idea.title: Key idea
key_idea.text: Surface area of a prism = 2 times the end face area plus the lateral (side) area. The lateral area equals perimeter of cross-section times length.
key_idea.caption: A = area of end face, P = perimeter of end, l = length of prism

modelled_examples.label: Example 1 – cuboid
modelled_examples.question: Find the surface area of a cuboid 6 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm.
modelled_examples.explanation: A cuboid has three different pairs of rectangular faces.

modelled_examples.label: Example 2 – triangular prism
modelled_examples.question: A triangular prism has a right-angled triangle cross-section (base 6, height 8, hypotenuse 10 cm) and length 12 cm. Find the SA.
modelled_examples.explanation: Find all five faces: two triangles and three rectangles.

modelled_examples.label: Example 3 – L-shaped prism
modelled_examples.question: An L-shaped prism has cross-section area 20 cm², perimeter 24 cm, and length 10 cm. Find the SA.
modelled_examples.explanation: Use the general formula when end area and perimeter are given.

modelled_examples.label: Example 4 – trapezoidal prism
modelled_examples.question: A prism has a trapezium cross-section with parallel sides 5 cm and 9 cm, height 4 cm, slant sides 5 cm each, and length 15 cm.
steps: End area: ½(5 + 9) × 4 = 28 cm². Two ends = 56 cm²
modelled_examples.explanation: Find the trapezium area, then use SA = 2A + Pl.
